subject: Agent runtime state ownership and Git synchronization
statement: Agent DevTools treats `.agent-work` and other session/runtime state as disposable and local to each agent instance or checkout; `.agent-knowledge` and other tracked durable artifacts belong to the project and synchronize through Git. Agents do not need to share one `.agent-work`; handoff/preserve is used only when unfinished recoverable state must be transferred.

sourceSession.taskGoal: Capture agreed durable conclusions about multi-agent runtime ownership and dogfood
